bait_content.title: I/O Conflict: Package Database Locked
bait_content.body: Concurrent update activity detected. Resource /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend is held by pid 1912 (snapd). To prevent database corruption, write operations have been paused and pending updates were queued. Close other update tools or restart the update service to continue.
